question: How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in the second quarter of 2026?

answer: Tesla does not disclose Cybertruck deliveries. Its Q2 2026 delivery release reports only Model 3/Y deliveries of 467,762 and 'Other Models' deliveries of 12,364 (total 480,126), and the Q2 2026 update deck and 10-Q give no model-level Cybertruck unit count (Cybertruck appears only in the installed-capacity table, >125,000 per year at Gigafactory Texas, which is not a delivery figure). Any Cybertruck figure would be a third-party estimate. [T18-E1, T18-E2, T18-E3]

output.answer:
**Question:** How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in the second quarter of 2026?
*As of 2026-10-03*

- Tesla does not report a standalone Cybertruck delivery figure; its Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) production and delivery report discloses only two vehicle buckets, "Model 3/Y" and "Other Models". [1]
- Tesla delivered 12,364 "Other Models" vehicles in Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026), a bucket that includes Cybertruck, Model S/X and Semi, as reported in the company's Q2 2026 production and deliveries release. [1]
- Tesla's Q2 FY2026 total deliveries were 480,126 vehicles (quarter ended June 30, 2026), as reported in the company's production and deliveries release. [1]
- Electrek reported that the "Other Models" bucket — Model S, Model X, Cybertruck, and Semi — contributed 8,822 produced and 12,364 delivered in Q2 2026, confirming no Cybertruck-only split is published. [2]

**Not available**
- Cybertruck-only deliveries in Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026): Tesla reports deliveries only in two buckets, "Model 3/Y" and "Other Models" (which includes Cybertruck, Model S/X and Semi); no standalone Cybertruck delivery count appears in the Q2 FY2026 8-K production/deliveries release or the 10-Q. Third-party registration or analyst estimates are not company disclosures and are not provided here. [1][3]

**Sources**
[1] Tesla, Inc. earnings release for Q2 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-07-02) (www.sec.gov, 2026-07-02, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026046717/exhibit99111111.htm

[3] Tesla, Inc. 10-Q for Q2 FY2026 (filed 2026-07-23) (www.sec.gov, 2026-07-23, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026049270/tsla-20260630.htm
